_comment: Agama profile for the patina21 ISO. The live system loads it as a preset (agama config load) so the installer asks only for disk and user; the theme is asked at first boot by patina install. iso/test/answers.json adds what an unattended install needs. Everything it installs is openSUSE's: the product definition in iso/kiwi/root/usr/share/agama/products.d/patina21.yaml fixes the repositories and patterns.

post.name: patina21-enable-firstboot
post.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p /var/lib/patina21
systemctl enable patina21-firstboot.service
